pkgmetadata.longdescription: azukari keeps API keys out of configuration files and command lines. A configuration file holds a secret://SERVICE/ACCOUNT reference instead of the key; azukari, placed in front of a command, resolves each variable named with --env from the Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet, KeePassXC, oo7-daemon) and then execs the command with the value in its environment only. It is meant as the command of an MCP server entry, and can also hand a value through a sealed memfd (--fd) or print HTTP headers for a headers helper (--headers).
